description: Implementation of the ExponentialBiased class functions for generating biased exponential random numbers, including methods for getting skip counts and stride, with internal initialization and random number handling.

classes.name: ExponentialBiased
classes.description: Class providing methods to generate biased exponential random numbers with internal state management.

methods.name: GetSkipCount
methods.description: Calculates the number of steps to skip based on a biased exponential distribution, using a random number generator and internal bias state.

methods.name: GetStride
methods.description: Returns the stride length based on the mean, utilizing GetSkipCount.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the internal state and random seed for the exponential biased generator, using a global atomic counter and multiple iterations to shuffle bits.
